# A statement that makes one pure call twice makes it once, in a local the
# statement then reads. The duplicates are mostly the compiler's own: a pass
# that substitutes an argument into a body leaves a copy at every use.
#
# Two calls with different arguments are two values and stay two calls; an
# impure call is not touched at all, since moving one changes when it runs.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=go app.sngl

# Bound once, read twice.
grep '__cse0 := Weight\(m.seed\)' go/model.go
grep 'm.total = \(__cse0 \+ \(__cse0 \* 2\)\)' go/model.go

# Different arguments: nothing merged, and the repeat of the first argument is
# its own temp.
grep '__cse1 := Weight\(m.a\)' go/model.go
grep '__cse1 \* 100' go/model.go
grep 'Weight\(m.b\)' go/model.go

# A statement holding an impure call keeps both of its calls: hoisting one
# across the other would move a read across a write.
grep 'm.log = \(m.noisy\(\) \+ m.noisy\(\)\)' go/model.go
! grep '__cse2' go/model.go

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=web app.sngl
grep 'let __cse0 = weight\(state.seed\);' web/index.html
grep 'state.total = __cse0 \+ __cse0 \* 2;' web/index.html

# android reaches the handler body by a different route: its primitives
# declare the callback as a prop, so the body is a lambda in the node's props
# and NodeInst.Handlers is empty. Walking the view for handlers found nothing
# here, and this handler made the call twice while every other target bound a
# temp.
sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=droid app.sngl
grep 'var __cse0 = weight\(seed\)' droid/MainScreen.kt
grep 'total = \(__cse0 \+ \(__cse0 \* 2\)\)' droid/MainScreen.kt
grep 'var __cse1 = weight\(a\)' droid/MainScreen.kt
grep 'weight\(b\)' droid/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

func weight(n int) int {
    if n > 2 {
        return n * 3 + 1
    }
    return 0
}

component main {
    var total = 0
    var seed = 4
    var a = 4
    var b = 3
    var log = 0
    var ticks = 0

    // Impure: it writes state, so the two calls below are two events.
    func noisy() int {
        ticks = ticks + 1
        return ticks
    }

    button(text="one", @click {
        total = weight(seed) + weight(seed) * 2
    })
    button(text="two", @click {
        total = weight(a) * 100 + weight(b) + weight(a)
    })
    button(text="three", @click {
        log = noisy() + noisy()
    })
    text(value=string(total) + string(log))
}
